_meta.title: Scrape 3 gap fill — Planet-Randy Munich / München city tag
_meta.source_scope_before: Berlin, Hamburg and Cologne city tags; 16 pages with complete checked pagination
_meta.primary_gap_found: Munich priority city had no Planet-Randy city-tag scrape even though site has dedicated 3-page Munich index.
required_deconfliction: Already existing proposals and live locations must be matched by alias/landmark, not counted twice.
A8/Hofolding, A96/Germering, B471/Ismaning are unresolved probable cross-source matches.
Staffelsee and Tegernsee are outside Munich or too broad to infer exact meeting area.
Wörthsee has a 2025 negative visitor report. Do not assume any source listing is currently busy.

blocked_pages.status: Direct web fetch and next-page navigation cache miss; NOT researched zero.

_meta.caution: The site advertises older descriptions and dated visitor reviews. Preserve location-specific source pages and dates, but don't assert validation of 2026 activity, exact GPS, typical age or permission to conduct sex in public. No profiles/user data collected.
